usageNotes: Use this to retrieve the raw text of the Ceph configuration file (ceph.conf) as seen by a specific cluster node. The calling principal needs either Sys.Audit or Datastore.Audit on the root path. The targeted node must be online and have Ceph configured — calling against a node without Ceph will return an error.

examples.summary: Fetch the raw Ceph config from node pve1

tips: The response is a plain string (the raw ceph.conf content), not a structured JSON object — handle it as text.
All nodes in a healthy Ceph cluster should return identical ceph.conf content; comparing output across nodes is a quick consistency check.
Use this as a read-only audit tool before making Ceph configuration changes to capture a baseline snapshot.
